# agent-runtimes Documentation Index

> Universal runtime layer for local AI coding agents (opencode, claude,
> codex). One API: Runtime → Session → Run → RuntimeEvent. TypeScript,
> Node >= 20, Apache-2.0. Package: agent-runtimes (unpublished, local path).

## Getting Started

- Overview: docs/dev/getting-started/overview.md — what it is/isn't, the four-step flow.
- 101: docs/dev/getting-started/101.md — why CLIs differ and what gets normalized.
- Install: docs/dev/getting-started/install.md — build from source, verify with doctor.
- Quickstart: docs/dev/getting-started/quickstart.md — first run: detect → session → run → events.

## Core Concepts

- Core model: docs/dev/concepts/core-model.md — Runtime ≠ Session ≠ Run ≠ Transport ≠ Parser; Session spans Processes.
- Events: docs/dev/concepts/events.md — 9 RuntimeEvent types, runId, reasoning_delta, cancel-done semantics.
- Capabilities: docs/dev/concepts/capabilities.md — branch on capabilities(), never runtime.id.
- Rules: docs/dev/concepts/rules.md — the seven hard rules (Rule 1–7).

## Discovery (read-only)

- Installs: docs/dev/discovery/installs.md — runtime.installs(), findAllInstalls(), per-platform recognition.
- Models & auth: docs/dev/discovery/models-auth.md — models(), auth(), model validation at createSession.
- MCP, skills, plugins: docs/dev/discovery/media-skills.md — mcp(), skills(), plugins() metadata only.
- Updates: docs/dev/discovery/updates.md — npm registry check, Version row "→ latest" suffix.
- Doctor: docs/dev/discovery/doctor.md — doctor(), reason codes, exit codes.

## Running

- Sessions: docs/dev/running/sessions.md — createSession options (cwd, model, reasoning, mcpServers, workspace).
- Streaming: docs/dev/running/runs-streaming.md — run.events(), one active run per session.
- Lifecycle: docs/dev/running/lifecycle.md — cancel (terminal done) vs close (silent), timeouts.
- Workspace: docs/dev/running/workspace.md — allowedPaths, sandbox, permission modes.
- Permissions: docs/dev/running/permissions.md — permission_request flow, respondToPermission.
- Images: docs/dev/running/images.md — path-primary image input per turn.
- History: docs/dev/running/history.md — session.history() from native transcripts, privacy rules.

## Guides

- Frontend wire: docs/dev/guides/frontend-wire.md — NDJSON framing, wire types (see docs/frontend.md).
- Cross-platform: docs/dev/guides/cross-platform.md — Windows/POSIX shims, signals, paths (see docs/cross-platform.md).
- Multi-agent: docs/dev/guides/multi-agent.md — shared workspace, CONTEXT.md blackboard, partitioning.
- New runtime: docs/dev/guides/new-runtime.md — authoring an adapter as a pressure test (see docs/runtime-authoring.md).

## Resources

- Errors: docs/dev/resources/errors.md — RuntimeError hierarchy (6 subclasses), fail-open philosophy.
- CLI: docs/dev/resources/cli.md — `doctor <id>` reference.
- FAQ: docs/dev/resources/faq.md — common questions.

## Key API signatures

```ts
import { runtimes } from "agent-runtimes";
const runtime = await runtimes.resolve("opencode" | "claude" | "codex");
const status = await runtime.detect(); // { installed: true, executable, version } | { installed: false }
const session = await runtime.createSession({ cwd?: string; model?: string });
const run = await session.run(prompt: string);
for await (const event of run.events()) { /* RuntimeEvent */ }
await run.cancel(); // ends stream with terminal `done`
await session.close();
const history = await session.history({ limit?: number; since?: number });
const installs = await runtime.installs(); // InstalledCopy[] { binary, shims, version, manager, invocable, selected }
```
